scenes.title: Sela at pier four
scenes.summary: The party meets Sela Thorn, a tide-reader mending a net, who will row them out for two silver (Oren's persuasion 14), but never at night. She says Saltmere flooded the night the bell first rang forty years ago, and the water came up warm. She will wait at pier four at first light.

scenes.title: Saltmere Mine
scenes.summary: The mine entrance is warm and smells of candle wax. The tunnel is flooded with warm black water and hymn-book pages. A margin note reads "M. Brand", which Teo recognises as his sister Mira's handwriting. Dana and Priya speculate that harbor-master Maren is in the cult. Dana's investigation (9) finds nothing more, and Oren takes 2 damage from bad air (down to 11).

scenes.title: Midnight at the drowned chapel
scenes.place: Shore below the drowned chapel, Gullwick bay
scenes.summary: At dusk the party goes to the shore despite Sela's warning. Fishermen warn of the Kelp Mother and leave. At midnight the bell rings twelve times underwater and the humming is louder than before. Pale shapes stand in rows on the chapel floor, then vanish. The party flees. The GM notes privately that the choir clock is at three of six.

scenes.title: Stew at the Tarred Gull
scenes.summary: The party plans to dive to the chapel at low tide the next day, with Sela rowing them at first light. Innkeeper Bram feeds them and says Maren is a good-hearted old acquaintance who lost a brother to the bay. The party takes a long rest and is back to full.
